claims.text: The CoVoST dataset was created from 11 languages into English, involving over 11,000 speakers and more than 60 accents.
The dataset creation methodology includes empirical evidence of data quality and initial benchmarks for multilingual models.
CoVoST is released under a CC0 license, indicating it is free to use.
